propositions: DC lacks convergence suites that verify oversized comments and descriptions truncate idempotently over two passes, unlike Cloud which has incident-hardened suites for both

DC's comment sanitizer incorrectly reuses the description fitter (fit_outbound) bound to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT, coupling comment truncation to description logic and creating maintenance risk if the description fitter changes

The 32767 character ceiling for DC comments is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit (covering comments, description, and text fields per JRASERVER-28519), not an unverified assumption, but this provenance is not cited in source

DC convergence tests driven through compute_outbound_mutations without explicit backend injection fall back to Cloud's backend via select_backend(load_config()), causing tests to pass while testing the wrong deployment

DC comment convergence cannot be tested through compute_outbound_mutations because _diff_comments independently resolves the sanitizer from config, bypassing any injected mapper and targeting Cloud's path
